items.criterion: grep -n '447' README.md prints nothing; every count line quotes 450 and 452 or the command that produces them
items.detail: `grep -n '447' README.md` -> exit_code 1, no output. All four count locations now quote 450/452: README.md:159 "- 450 .spec.md files (452 incl .scl) with proper headers and references"; README.md:495 "specs/  # Source of truth (450 .spec.md files, 452 incl .scl)"; README.md:541 "- **Spec validation**: All 452 specs have valid headers and references"; README.md:635 "**Specs**: 450 .spec.md (452 incl .scl) | ...". The fifth stale line (old "# Output: 449 specs validated") is now README.md:355-356 "# Output: one Validation Report block per spec, each PASSED / # (for the live spec count, run: node bin/speclang status)" — i.e. the command that produces the count. `grep -n -E '\b(44[0-9]|45[0-9]|46[0-9])\b' README.md` returns only those four count lines plus README.md:364 "holds 466 entries", which is the _index.json entry count, not a spec count. Live figures confirmed: `find specs -name '*.spec.md' | wc -l` -> 450, `find specs -name '*.scl' | wc -l` -> 2, `node bin/speclang status` -> "Specs: 452 (450 .spec.md + 2 .scl)". Remaining 447/449 strings are outside README.md (PACKAGING.md:101, docs/dogfood/diagnostics.md:15-18, specs/skills.spec.dir/skills/speclang-usage.md:71) and in .tmp/rev9-prefix/README.md, which is gitignored (.gitignore:98 `.tmp/`) and untracked (`git ls-files | grep -c '^\.tmp/'` -> 0). Tests: `npx vitest run tests/npm12-remedy-doc.test.ts tests/layers.test.ts` -> exit_code 0, "Test Files 2 passed (2) / Tests 39 passed (39)". [resolution 0.19; README.md]

items.criterion: The quoted figures (450 .spec.md, 452 incl .scl) match the live tree and the tool the README points readers to (`node bin/speclang status`), so the corrected numbers are not themselves stale.
items.detail: `find specs -name '*.spec.md' | wc -l` -> 450; `find specs -name '*.scl' | wc -l` -> 2 (specs/project.scl, specs/templates.spec.dir/src/project.scl); `node bin/speclang status` -> "Specs: 452 (450 .spec.md + 2 .scl)". README.md:159/495/541/635 quote exactly 450 and 452, and README.md:356 directs readers to `node bin/speclang status`, which exists at bin/speclang and prints those figures.
